headline: Bank of the Republic of Haiti Issues Regulatory Circular to Financial Institutions
summary: The Bank of the Republic of Haiti has issued Circular 40-1 to commercial banks and money transfer houses across the country.
why: The Bank of the Republic of Haiti acts as the central monetary authority and regulator of Haiti's financial system.
